classification.difficultyReason: Same task as p11-q10. Read the three-set diagram, total the four regions inside one circle, then subtract that from the given total of 160 and simplify. Nothing is missing.

content.prompt:
A school surveyed 160 students about the sports they play. The results are recorded in the Venn diagram below.

If one of the students is selected at random, what is the probability that the student does not play cricket?

answer.worked: $\begin{aligned}\text{Students who play cricket} &= 22+7+9+4=42\\\text{Students who do not play cricket} &= 160-42=118\\P(\text{does not play cricket}) &= \frac{118}{160}=\frac{59}{80}\end{aligned}$
